value.signature: fn check_content (& self , row : & RawResult < '_ > , parent : Option < & RawResult < '_ > > , meter : & mut AuditMeter ,) -> Result < () , AuditFailure >

exception.justification: Justified: Private field access or reconciliation inherits the enclosing observed position or server audit operation.

review.body: { let site = AuditSite :: row ("pn_epoch_results" , & [SitePart :: Scope (row . scope) , SitePart :: Identity (row . identity)] ,) ; if let Some (parent) = parent { let child = crate :: storage :: tree :: server :: spans :: Validated :: audit (row . content () . package . as_ref () , meter , site) ? ; let prior = crate :: storage :: tree :: server :: spans :: Validated :: audit (parent . content () . package . as_ref () , meter , site) ? ; let valid = crate :: storage :: tree :: server :: projection :: extends_match (& child , & prior) . map_err (| _ | meter . refused (StorageError :: CorruptHistory , site)) ? ; if ! valid { return Err (meter . refused (StorageError :: CorruptHistory , site)) ; } } Self :: position (row , parent , meter) ? ; Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: The private operation reads public retained facts under the one observed, bounded position or server audit operation, and cannot expose credentials or a driver diagnostic.
